findings.detail: F16 compares an annualized distribution rate with a three-month net investment income ratio; annualizing 2.20% gives 8.80%, above the observed 7.358% distribution rate.

rationale: The financial-highlights table labels the period as the three months ended March 31, 2026 and reports net investment income of 2.20% for that quarter. The F16 observed distribution rate of 7.357966% is annualized, so comparing it directly with 2.20% mixes period bases. On the comparable annual basis, the source income ratio is 8.80% (2.20% x 4), and 7.357966% is below both 8.80% and the rule's 13.20% threshold. The underlying values are source-supported; the heuristic fire is a false alarm caused by an invalid period-basis anchor comparison.
